gangs_by_prefix.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "GangCode" FROM "HR_GANGLN" WHERE "GangCode" LIKE ? ORDER BY "GangCode"
gangs_by_prefix.description: List gang codes filtered by code prefix

gangs_with_desc_by_prefix.sql: SELECT g."GangCode", g."Description" FROM "HR_GANG" g JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "GangCode" FROM "HR_GANGLN") ln ON ln."GangCode" = g."GangCode" WHERE g."GangCode" LIKE ? ORDER BY g."GangCode"
gangs_with_desc_by_prefix.description: List gang code and description filtered by code prefix
